freeze_point: after structural, referential, authority-consistency and local-semantic PASS; before set assembly/comparison
version_rule: successful legitimate thaw increments artifact_revision exactly once; stale repair is rejected without mutation
downstream_invalidation: invalidate only assembly/comparison receipts and artifacts inside proven bounded closure; preserve unrelated frozen payload hashes
deterministic_recomputation: derived metadata, closure and assembly hashes recompute from canonical inputs only
